entries.rationale: Install fourteen approved packages, preserve the accepted Home-only overlay and regenerate complete agent composition; installation is distinct from release targets and downstream rollout.
readerPaths: README → bounded rollout report → source lock, installed lock and delivery PR
entries.navigationImpact: Both README language partners link the bounded installation record; historical publication records remain intact.
entries.languageStrategy: German first and English second; paired README files and synchronized guidance.
entries.platformAndExampleProof: macOS matrix checks in Bash and PowerShell, preserved-overlay tests, complete composed-agent parity; applicable native CI bound to the exact PR head.
entries.risk: Home Runtime sync follows successful Level-0 delivery; no implicit community, fleet, feature or toolchain authority.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: Preset, priority, composition, override or runtime-distribution change.

entries.rationale: Create a separate current technical context and bind the actual installed snapshot without rewriting historical evidence or human decisions.
readerPaths: Rollout report → current context → four gate records/runbooks → executed command evidence
entries.navigationImpact: A distinct dated context preserves older v0.1.3 evidence and points to the bounded rollout report.
entries.languageStrategy: Bilingual matrix/runbooks; language-neutral JSON keys, paths and hashes.
entries.platformAndExampleProof: Both shell status and four gate reviews with raw-byte read-only snapshots; negative fixtures and exact installed payload validation.
entries.risk: Technical integrity checks do not establish complete control implementation, human product acceptance or regulatory/certification approval.
entries.reevaluationTrigger: Controlled-document, installed payload, scope or authority change.

entries.navigationImpact: Existing ledger and last overall-statistics section retained.
